notice.title: Fraud monitoring for instant payments
notice.aiSummary: Firms that send instant payments must implement real-time fraud screening before releasing payments and provide 24/7 fraud reporting channels for customers. Compliance is required by April 1, 2027.
notice.aiReason: The notice applies to payment service providers that send instant payments, and Brivanta Bank offers instant account-to-account payments in its mobile app.

text:
PAYMENTS OVERSIGHT COUNCIL FICTIONAL REGULATOR - SYNTHETIC EXAMPLE
Guidance: Fraud monitoring for instant payments
Notice number: RCN-2026-014
Issued by: Payments Oversight Council
Published: 2026-10-20
Effective date: 2027-04-01
1. Who this applies to
Payment service providers that send instant payments.
2. Background
Instant payments settle in seconds, so fraud controls must act before the money leaves.
3. Requirements
3.1 A firm must screen outgoing instant payments for fraud in real time, before the payment is released.
3.2 A firm must give customers a way to report fraud that is available 24 hours a day, every day.
4. Status
Firms must comply with the requirements in section 3 from 2027-04-01.

obligations.text: A firm must screen outgoing instant payments for fraud in real time, before the payment is released.
obligations.controlDesc: Real-time fraud engine scores every outgoing instant payment before release; bypasses are logged and reviewed
obligations.reason: Policy POL-FRD-01 states "Outgoing instant payments are scored by the real-time fraud engine before release" and Control CTL-171 confirms "Real-time fraud engine scores every outgoing instant payment before release", which exactly matches the obligation's requirement to screen outgoing instant payments for fraud in real time before release.

obligations.text: A firm must give customers a way to report fraud that is available 24 hours a day, every day.
obligations.controlDesc: Daily test call to the 24/7 fraud reporting line
obligations.reason: Policy POL-FRD-01 states "Customers can report fraud by phone or in the app 24 hours a day, every day" which exactly matches the obligation's requirement, and CTL-172 performs a daily test call to verify the 24/7 fraud reporting line remains available.
